runs.question: What are the four functions of the NIST AI RMF Core?

answer.text:
The NIST AI RMF Core has four functions: GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE The Core is composed of four functions: GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE. Each one is divided further, into categories and subcategories.

GOVERN works differently from the other three. The framework says it applies to all stages of an organization's AI risk management processes, while MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE can be applied in system-specific contexts and at particular stages of the AI lifecycle (1-2). Within the Core, governance is meant to run across the other three functions rather than sit as a separate step (2-3).

The passages do not say that the functions must run in a fixed sequence. They state that, once a governance structure is in place, functions may be performed in any order across the AI lifecycle as deemed to add value by a user of the framework.

The retrieved passages do not give a detailed description of what each individual function involves beyond these points, so I can't say more about them from these sources.
